per_rule.rule: S_N must not contain NULL values because it is the join key to Cust_Bio_dirty.
Account_No must be exactly four numeric characters.
ID must follow the nine‑character pattern: a leading letter, seven alphanumeric characters, and a trailing letter (e.g., S8403757E).
Flag IDs that use the short 7‑character format (e.g., S123456) as potential sentinel values.
JoinDate must be parseable as a datetime (YYYY‑MM‑DD HH:MM:SS or YYYY‑MM‑DD).
JoinDate must not be later than today because it records the historical join date of a customer.
LastLogin must be parseable as a datetime in the format YYYY‑MM‑DD HH:MM:SS.
LastLogin must not be later than today because it records a past login event.
Subscription_Type must be one of the allowed tiers: Basic, Free, Gold, Platinum, Premium.
SubscriptionFee must be convertible to a numeric value (float).
Flag the literal string 'free' in SubscriptionFee as a sentinel/non‑numeric placeholder.
Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
Flag the extreme values 99999.0 and -150.5 in AccountBalance as sentinel codes.
AccountBalance must not be negative (negative values are anomalous for a balance).
PreferredLanguage must be one of the supported languages: English, French, German, Malay, Tamil.
Device must be one of: Mobile, Desktop, Tablet.
OS must be one of the canonical operating‑system names: Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, Windows.
OS values must match the canonical set irrespective of case.
Flag the outlier value 7.3 in FeedbackScore as a sentinel code.
Flag the outlier value 7.3 in FeedbackScore1 as a sentinel code (if present).
FeedbackScore and FeedbackScore1 must contain identical values for each record.
Every S_N value must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N (one‑to‑one relationship).
If Full_Name contains a male particle ("Bin", "s/o", "d/o") the linked Cust_Bio_dirty.Gender must be 'Male'; if it contains a female particle ("Binte", "d/o", "s/o") the gender must be 'Female'.
S_N must be unique within Acc_Info_dirty (one-to-one join key)
Account_No must be unique within Acc_Info_dirty
